Place phone calls and send emails from a Telegram assistant
An n8n assistant looks up contacts in Google Sheets, places real phone calls, sends emails and schedules calendar events for the user.
Done with
N8
n8n
What they did
This is a $30 pre-built n8n workflow that puts an assistant called Emily inside Telegram. It takes text or voice messages and uses OpenAI and Pinecone. Separate phone, email and calendar agents handle the requests, and contacts come from Google Sheets. The page gives only a short overview, with no detail on the mechanics.
How it went
The page gives no results, numbers or limitations. It is a product listing, not an account of real use.
Worth knowing
The listing is thin on setup details. Check what accounts, phone-calling services and API keys you need before buying.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build an n8n Telegram assistant that looks up people in my contacts sheet at [Google Sheets link], places phone calls through [voice calling service], sends emails, and schedules Google Calendar events when I ask. Before any call, email or invite goes out, it must show me the recipient and the exact message or script and wait for my approval. Test it by calling and emailing only me.
Original source: https://elitesolutions1.gumroad.com/l/PersonalAssistant
